scripts.docs:build: npm run sync:content -w apps/docs && npm run build -w apps/docs

scriptDocs.db:check: Fail if db/schema.sql drifts from migrations/ (SQLite sqldiff). Requires sqlite3 and sqldiff on PATH (apt: sqlite3 sqlite3-tools). CI db-check job installs both. See scripts/ci/check-migrations-sync.mjs and docs/specs.html#schema-migrations.
